description: Filter on a modernised transconductance-amplifier version of the MS-20 circuit, switchable between lowpass and highpass

params.text: Sets the frequency at which the filter starts to attenuate
Boosts the frequencies near the cutoff, and past a point the filter self-oscillates and can be played as a sound source
Attenuates and inverts the CV1 input before it is added to the cutoff, despite the manual calling it an attenuator
Attenuates and inverts the CV2 input before it is added to the cutoff, despite the manual calling it an attenuator
Sets how much signal enters the filter, and raising it saturates the filter and adds harmonics
Switches the filter between lowpass and highpass, which the two lamps show

inputs.text: The audio input to the filter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV1 knob
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV2 knob
